The splitting patterns suggest the presence of a para-substituted aromatic ring, as indicated by the doublet of doublets. The aliphatic protons are likely part of a chain or substituent attached to the aromatic ring. To further narrow down the structure, I will check the mass spectrometry spectra to determine the molecular weight and possible fragments.</thought>

<thought>The mass spectrometry data shows a major peak at m/z 198.9997, which suggests a molecular weight of approximately 199 g/mol. This information, combined with the NMR data, suggests a compound with an aromatic ring and aliphatic chains. The isotopic pattern indicates the presence of a chlorine atom, as seen from the characteristic isotope peaks. Given the molecular weight and the NMR data, a likely candidate is ethylbenzene with a chlorine substituent. I will now generate possible isomers for a molecular formula that fits this data and check for a match.</thought>
